content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight","priority":30,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"fight-back"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"neq","value":11}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-ladder"}},{"id":"navigate-y","priority":9,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.y","op":"neq","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-ladder"}}]},"skills":[{"name":"fight-back","skill":"async (b) => { const me = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); if (!ms.length) return; const m = ms[0]; const dx = m.x - me.x, dy = m.y - me.y; if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) === 1) { await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } else { await b.walkTo(m.x, m.y, 'adjacent'); await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } }","check":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); return {ok: ms.length === 0, detail: 'monsters: ' + ms.length}; }"},{"name":"go-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const me = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); for (const m of ms) { if (Math.abs(m.x - me.x) + Math.abs(m.y - me.y) <= 2) { await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } } await b.walkTo(11, 1, 'stand'); }","check":"async (b) => { const me = await b.body(); return {ok: me.x === 11 && me.y === 1, detail: 'at ' + me.x + ',' + me.y}; }"}]}
